title: Media upload pipeline has solid security layering
description: src/media.rs:161-295. The upload pipeline: (1) limits body size to configured max_media_mb, (2) sniffs MIME from magic bytes rather than trusting Content-Type, (3) re-encodes the image through fieldwork::media_processing which strips EXIF/metadata, (4) caps dimensions to 4096px, (5) generates blurhash server-side, (6) writes a .meta sidecar for recovery. Step 3 is the most important — re-encoding prevents polyglot attacks (JPEG that's also valid HTML/JS). This is defense in depth done right.
